newsitem.title: UK: BZW names Morolli Europe credit research director.
newsitem.headline: BZW names Morolli Europe credit research director.

text.p: Former IBCA director Maurizio Morolli will join BZW in March as a director in the European credit research team, BZW said in a statement on Wednesday.

Morolli, 34, has been a director of London credit rating agency IBCA for six years, where he headed a team of five analysts rating Italian banks, insurance companies, local authorities and corporates.

"Maurizio's appointment reflects both our commitment to developing a credit research function that will fully encompass Europe and to the increasing importance of the credit business generally," said Gary Jenkins, head of the European credit team.
